name: fde-demo-builder
description: Turn a raw screen recording into a polished, VO-narrated, privacy-scrubbed demo video — fully scripted (ffmpeg + edge-tts + headless Chrome), no video editor. v2 adds cinematic story rebuilds: word-synced animated b-roll acts (openers/interstitials/finales) and multi-voice narration placed over existing recordings. Built for FDE product demos.

author.name: Ahmed Awan - Forward Deployed Engineering Team
